obligations.note: The new route GET /exports/cases.csv uses the privileged action EXPORT_CASES but sets mfaRequired=false (Routes.java:31), and HttpApp.refuseSession enforces MFA only from that flag. The exhaustive control test RoutesControlTest#privilegedRoutesRequireMfa fails on the head commit for exactly this route.

Ticket CHG-24618 is a standard ticket, approved on 2026-09-29 by change manager Erik Brandt, before the PR opened and before review. Its component mortgage.http covers both changed files (HttpApp.java, Routes.java).
The code_review approval is from Declan Farrell, a change_approver for baseline-mortgage and a different person from the author Wen Li under all of Wen Li's directory addresses.
Both approvals name the head commit 2ce566d, which is the only commit in the change.

The change's CI run on head 2ce566d has result 'failure': the registered MFA-1 control test privilegedRoutesRequireMfa fails. The suite is therefore not passing on the final commit, despite the PR's 'full suite green locally' claim.
The change touches security-sensitive mortgage.http files. A security_review approval from Ines Halvorsen (security_reviewer role) is recorded on the head commit.
The change deviates from MFA-1 and no valid exception covers it. The only MFA-1 entry, EXC-0172, is withdrawn, has no risk-owner approval, and was scoped to the health route.
No acceptance-ledger entry covers the changed files. The only MFA-1 ledger evidence covers payments routes.py, which this change does not touch, so no prior evidence lapses.

summary: The change adds a .csv alias for the privileged case-export route but turns off MFA on it, so case exports can be fetched without step-up MFA. This violates MFA-1, and no valid exception covers it. The change's own CI run on the final commit failed because of this: the exhaustive MFA-1 control test reports that GET /exports/cases.csv does not require MFA. The ticket, independent code review and security review are in order, but the MFA-1, CHG-4 and EXC-1 failures require rejection.
